findings.pixelObservation: The selected skill glyph is displaced over the future-boundary filter at roughly x254-343/y338-420. Current-equipped state is squeezed into a one-character vertical strip at roughly x299 between directory and object body. The central study illustration is practically invisible, leaving a large empty dark area.
findings.likelySourceCause: Old idle-preparation.css .learning-scroll retains align-items:start. New stage-r3 changes display to column flex but leaves that cross-axis rule; preparation-art content is absolutely positioned and has width:auto, allowing a near-zero width box. Source-derived causal explanation fits the actual pixels; final fix still needs fresh pixels.
findings.fixSuggestion: Explicitly stretch .learning-scroll children and give preparation-art full available width; retain the real icon/status and themed art. Add assertions for art width, glyph bounds within art and status readable horizontal width, not only button hit tests.

findings.pixelObservation: Fourth relic card lower border and directory page label overlap by a few pixels around y670-677. Previous/next controls stack vertically below the label. They remain above the bottom navigation, but the label has no clear separation from the fourth card.
findings.likelySourceCause: The left catalogue is 200px. Inherited .catalogue-pager button min-width:100px plus gap is wider than one row, creating the unwanted stack and height demand. Four 82px cards plus 10px gaps also exhaust available row height.
findings.fixSuggestion: Set relic pager button width/min-width around84px so both fit with unchanged readable text. If still needed use78px card minimum and8px gap (not smaller text), then assert fourth-card bottom<=pager top and review actual pixels.
